inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description:
Aria label for the avatar group container.
When not provided, a default label is generated from the i18n `coreAvatarGroup.ariaLabelGroup` key
for group type, or `coreAvatarGroup.ariaLabelIndividual` for individual type,
using the current displayed and hidden avatar counts as context.

inputs.name: maxVisibleItems
inputs.description:
Maximum number of avatars to display before the overflow button appears.
When set, the group shows exactly this many avatars regardless of the container width.
When `null` (default), visibility is determined by the available container width.

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.description:
Orientation of the AvatarGroup control.

`horizontal`: The avatars are displayed horizontally.
`vertical`: The avatars are displayed vertically.

inputs.name: overflowButtonShape
inputs.description:
Shape of the default overflow button.
Use `'circle'` when the avatar group displays circle avatars, so the overflow button matches their shape.
Has no effect when a custom overflow button is provided via `fdAvatarGroupOverflowButton`.

inputs.name: overflowHeadingLevel
inputs.description: Heading level for the overflow popover title.

inputs.name: overflowPopoverTitle
inputs.description:
The title which is displayed when user opens the overflow popover.
This takes effect only when default overflow popover body is used,
otherwise the title should be set on the custom overflow popover body component.

inputs.name: popoverPlacement
inputs.description:
Placement of the group overflow popover relative to the avatar group.
Defaults to `'right'` when `orientation="vertical"`, otherwise `'bottom'`.
Use `'bottom-start'` / `'bottom-end'` to align to an edge.
Only applies to `type="group"`.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description:
The spacing between the items depends on the size of the avatars in the group.
The size is also used for the default overflow button.
`xs`, `s`, `m`, `l`, `xl`

inputs.name: type
inputs.description:
The AvatarGroup control has two group types:

`group`: The avatars are displayed as partially overlapped on top of each other and the entire group has one click/tap area.
`individual`: The avatars are displayed side-by-side and each avatar has its own click/tap area.
